steps.what: Select verified investigation findings and source passages for reports
Prepare report narrative from selected findings

loop.purpose: Draft a source-linked account without adding conclusions
loop.input: Report brief and authorised source passages
loop.output: Draft narrative with passage references and unresolved gaps
loop.check: Detective compares every assertion, qualification, chronology and attribution with original evidence
loop.stop: One draft and correction pass; write manually when sources conflict or verification is slower
loop.why_not_simpler: Narrative findings require contextual wording; fixed fields cover only the report header

steps.what: Resolve omissions and approve final investigation report

tasks.design: Try approved drafting functions in {DOCS} on a restricted case workspace. A bounded draft uses only the detective's selected material, and the detective approves the complete report after source comparison.
tasks.previous_blocker: Narrative tools could omit exculpatory detail or turn an uncertain observation into a fact.
tasks.enabler_now: Source-linked drafts can be tested without delegating evidential conclusions.
tasks.still_hard: Verification can consume all drafting gains.
tasks.human_edge: Distinguish an observation, allegation and inference, including evidence against the working theory.
tasks.altitude: Writing may shorten slightly; investigative and report accountability remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: Axon Draft One drafts patrol reports from bodycam audio with officer confirmation; this is adjacent to investigative findings reports.
A Draft One randomised trial found no faster report writing, while a department reported a gain; neither establishes local investigative report savings.
The small drafting gain is an unmeasured model-knowledge scenario and may disappear after verification.

assumptions: Boundary starts with existing case evidence and ends with internal report approval; evidence collection and subsequent prosecutorial decisions are outside and unchanged.

Detective produces case ID, report scope, audience, template version, source IDs and versions, selected passages, uncertainties and attribution in s1's retained 30 hours. Missing metadata or permission sends the report to manual drafting; no free verified-fact flag exists.
Test native approved document functions before custom code; existing storage runtime earns no saving.
No new supervisor review is assumed. Focal upkeep is six hours per 100 baseline for sampled output checks and prompt/template maintenance.
unknowns: Approved access to sensitive case data
Whether report drafting is already assisted
research_questions: Does full assertion-level verification leave any net saving on matched investigative reports?

already_counted.description: Source selection, narrative verification and final judgement

incremental.description: Restricted-workspace output sampling and template maintenance

approvals.approved_version: Final report text, source references, attachments and destination version; any edit voids approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R90 gross10 minus6 upkeep net4. Range0-2 allows no gain where full rereading offsets drafting, with a small gain only on straightforward source-complete reports.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Interview and observe suspects and witnesses to obtain evidence
Analyze records and verify evidence against independent sources

tasks.design: Keep interviewing, observation and evidential verification with the detective. Use existing {DOCS} source access without treating a generated summary as verified evidence.
tasks.previous_blocker: Witness accounts and records can conflict in ways that retrieval does not resolve.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing document access already supports comparison; no new automation is assumed.
tasks.still_hard: Reliability, context and lawful methods require case judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Ask follow-up questions and actively test alternative explanations.
tasks.altitude: No change in time or decision rights is claimed.

reach.task: Trace competing accounts to their sources

evidence.claim: BEAR tags sentences and orders documents; its summary approach was rejected because details matter. This does not automate verification of evidence.

assumptions: Boundary is substantive evidence acquisition and verification, not separate report writing. Where interviews also meet task23022, their time has one owner in a role roll-up.

Detective records source identity, time, original wording, circumstances and contradictions within s1 and s2. Witness answers arise during interviews; authorised record custodians supply existing records before s2. No structured credibility flag is assumed.
Native source access is retained; no custom tool or additional capture is introduced. Missing records prompt normal manual investigation.
Zero incremental upkeep because the task and existing access arrangements are unchanged.
unknowns: Relative share of field work and document analysis
research_questions: Which retrieval work, if any, is genuinely separate from substantive evidence verification?

incremental.description: No new process or tool upkeep

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 upkeep0 net0; field interaction and evidential judgement are retained, including conflicting-record cases.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Preserve, analyze and dispose of evidence

steps.what: Preserve and process evidence in proper containers
Analyze evidence using authorised methods and interpret findings
Verify disposal authority and destroy evidence no longer needed

tasks.design: Keep physical preservation, analysis and destruction with authorised staff. Existing procedure copies in {DOCS} can support the work, but no automated disposal or analytical conclusion is proposed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Correct handling depends on the material and evidential context.
tasks.enabler_now: No new enabler is claimed for the physical task.
tasks.still_hard: Destruction is irreversible and retention needs can change.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise contamination risks and question whether an item is truly no longer required.
tasks.altitude: Evidence responsibility and workload remain unchanged.

reach.task: Reconcile evidence custody and retention records

evidence.claim: Physical preservation, contextual analysis and authorised disposal are retained; no digest capability establishes labour savings for this task.

assumptions: Boundary covers the detective's evidence handling and analysis, not laboratory specialist work. Existing specialist services remain outside and unchanged.

Detective creates item identity, container/seal details, custody movements and findings during s1 and s2, with all capture retained. The existing case authority produces item-specific disposal permission after retention review and before s3; s3 includes verifying it and any holds. Missing or conflicting authority means retain the item, never infer disposal eligibility.
Native records and procedures remain in use; no new structured flags or custom code are introduced.
Zero incremental upkeep because no new tool, transfer or maintenance duty is introduced.
unknowns: Disposal authority and witness requirements under national rules
research_questions: Does the existing custody process already cover every item movement and disposal decision?

approvals.approved_version: Exact item IDs, disposal authority version, current hold check and destruction method at execution; changes require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 upkeep0 net0. Physical handling and disposal verification retain their time, including uncertain retention cases.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Obtain facts and statements during recorded interviews

tasks.design: Retain the human interview and existing recording device in {OTHER}. Recording already captures speech, so its runtime creates no new labour saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: The hard work is obtaining a reliable account through an appropriate interaction.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing recording equipment already supports the task.
tasks.still_hard: Language, distress, ambiguity and procedural safeguards vary by interview.
tasks.human_edge: Adapt questions while avoiding suggestion and preserving the person's actual account.
tasks.altitude: No change in interview duration or authority is assumed.

evidence.claim: Recorded interviewing remains a human interaction; transcription or report drafting is outside this task boundary.

assumptions: Boundary is obtaining and recording the interview, not subsequent transcription, analysis or reporting. Overlap with23034 is allocated once in a role roll-up.

OTHER means an interview recording device. Detective captures interview ID, participants, times, procedural context and recording reference during the retained100 hours; interviewees produce their answers during the conversation. No pre-existing transcript or truth flag is assumed; equipment failure uses the authorised manual recording procedure.
Test existing recorder operation; no custom processing or new capture task is introduced.
Zero incremental upkeep because equipment operation and the interview process remain unchanged.
unknowns: Recording procedures and interview support needs
research_questions: Which activities belong to the interview itself rather than separately counted report preparation?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 upkeep0 net0. Recording is already available; no reduction in conversation or procedural safeguards is assumed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: A small report-writing improvement is possible; evidence decisions and field work remain human.
reach: Learn source provenance with records officers
Learn competing-hypothesis analysis with intelligence analysts
role.ambitious_version: An investigator who tests competing explanations and can trace every report assertion to its evidence.
